findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but never deletes DB row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true does client.request cancel then returns without deleting or marking the WorkflowReminder row. The SMS version deletes the row, and cascade only cleans workflow-delete cases. For the reschedule path in handleNewBooking.ts the old booking row remains scheduled:true with no cancelled flag, so it is never retried by the cron and lingers until past-date cleanup. If the SendGrid cancel fails the email can still be sent with no retry.

findings.title: One SendGrid failure aborts all pending cancellations
findings.body: The for loop awaits client.request for each reminder to cancel and only after the loop runs Promise.all of queued prisma deletes. Any throw jumps to the outer catch, skipping remaining reminders and discarding deletes already queued in workflowRemindersToDelete. One bad batch_id therefore prevents cancellation/deletion of all other cancelled reminders in that cron run, leaving them to be sent.

findings.title: Workflow reminder cancels fire-and-forget in forEach
findings.body: updatedBookings.forEach calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder / deleteScheduledSMSReminder which are async prisma/twilio/SendGrid operations, but forEach is not awaited and the promises are not added to prismaPromises. The handler can return and finish the request before cancelled=true is persisted or SMS is cancelled/deleted, so the cron can still see/schedule the reminder and the email/SMS is still sent.

findings.title: Reschedule reminder cancels not awaited
findings.body: bookingToReschedule.workflowReminders.forEach invokes async deleteScheduledEmailReminder/deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting or collecting promises. The DB update to cancelled=true or delete may not complete before subsequent calendar/email work, so a concurrently running scheduleEmailReminders cron can still schedule/send the old reminder.

findings.title: Reschedule cleanup uses async forEach without await
findings.body: originalRescheduledBooking.workflowReminders.forEach calls async delete functions inside a try/catch but never awaits them. Exceptions from the async callbacks become unhandled rejections not caught by the surrounding try, and the SendGrid cancel / DB delete may not finish before reschedule proceeds, leaving old reminders active.

findings.title: SMS DB row leaked when Twilio cancel fails
findings.body: deleteScheduledSMSReminder does await twilio.cancelSMS then prisma delete in the same try. If cancelSMS throws because the message was already sent, failed, or the SID is invalid, the delete is skipped and the catch only logs. The WorkflowReminder row remains forever as scheduled, leaking data and confusing later workflow edit/delete logic. The row should be deleted even if provider cancel fails.

findings.title: Cron can schedule email after concurrent cancel
findings.body: unscheduledReminders is fetched without excluding cancelled=true and booking status is never re-checked. The loop then calls sgMail.send before the prisma update. If a booking is cancelled between the findMany and the send, handleCancelBooking will delete/mark the row but the cron has already sent the email via SendGrid. The send should happen after re-validating the reminder still exists and is not cancelled, or the update should precede the external send.
